title: Unattached gp2 EBS volume
evidence: Volume is in 'available' state, attached to no instance for 47 days.
confidence_reason: Detached state is deterministic; storage is not SP/RI-covered so list price is exact.
caveats: Snapshot before deletion unless covered by a manual backup process.

title: gp2 volume migratable to gp3
evidence: 1 TB gp2 volume; gp3 baseline (3000 IOPS / 125 MB/s) covers observed usage.
confidence_reason: gp2->gp3 is a live, zero-downtime modify; ~20% storage delta is deterministic.

title: Unassociated Elastic IP
evidence: Elastic IP allocated but associated with no running instance or ENI.
confidence_reason: Flat hourly charge for an idle public IPv4; unassociated state is deterministic.

title: EBS volume on long-stopped instance
evidence: Volume attached to instance i-0123456789abcdef0, stopped for 63 days; storage still billed.
confidence_reason: Stopped-instance storage is billed while compute is not; state is deterministic.
caveats: Confirm the instance is not awaiting a planned restart.

title: Orphaned EBS snapshots (source volume deleted)
evidence: 7 snapshots whose source volumes no longer exist; nominal 1.2 TB.
confidence_reason: Snapshots are incremental; realised saving is a range, not the nominal size.
caveats: Estimate is ranged because incremental snapshots free far less than nominal size.

title: Idle NAT gateway
evidence: BytesOutToDestination ~0 over 30 days; gateway still incurs the hourly charge.
confidence_reason: No traffic observed over 30 days on a standard CloudWatch metric.
caveats: Confirm no failover/standby role before removal.

title: Idle Application Load Balancer
evidence: Zero requests and no healthy targets over 30 days; hourly LCU baseline still billed.
confidence_reason: No requests and no healthy targets over 30 days (standard CloudWatch).

title: Low Savings Plans / RI coverage on steady-state compute
evidence: On-demand compute coverage at 38%; ~620 stable on-demand hours/day uncommitted.
confidence_reason: Coverage gap from CE; bounds are a heuristic band around CE's point estimate, not a tier comparison.
caveats: Assumes steady-state usage continues; commit only to the durable baseline.
